signal_evidence.capex_direction: As we progress towards Neutron's first flight, we expect capital expenditures to remain elevated as we invest in testing, production scaling and infrastructure expansion.
signal_evidence.pricing_power: We brought Neutron to market with a $50 million to $55 million ASP with a commitment really not to do any significant discounting for early launches. And we've stuck to that... we see more upside to ASPs and certainly anything that are down or sideways.
signal_evidence.management_tone_shift: I've personally never seen launch so constrained in pretty much ever... the demand for the vehicle is already very high... we have absolutely zero issues in selling full price Neutrons pre-test flights.
